registers.name: ID
registers.description: S4S1 memory/control identity.

registers.name: COMMAND_RESPONSE
registers.description: Write commands3=SET_OWNER,4=START,5=ABORT,6=SNAPSHOT,7=LOAD_TAPS; full strobes. Reads last mailbox AXI response (0 okay,2 failure). Backend completion sequence must advance.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: bit0 link busy,bit1 link fault,owner[3:2] from last response (0PARK/1CPU/2TEST), not live until mailbox command.

registers.name: SEQUENCE
registers.description: Mailbox completions, including failed operations.

registers.name: SIZE_BYTES
registers.description: 32MiB physical RAM, separate from CSRs.

registers.name: ABI
registers.description: Exclusive ownership ABI1.

registers.name: LINK_RECOVER
registers.description: Write1 with full strobes and link not busy to recover mailbox. Not automatic safe restoration of RAM contents.

registers.name: CONFIG_BASE_WORD
registers.description: 24-bit physical halfword start; tester uses bursts of8 halfwords.

registers.name: CONFIG_COUNT_WORDS
registers.description: 25-bit halfword count; base/count multiples8, nonzero, base+count<=16777216.

registers.name: CONFIG_PATTERNS_SEED
registers.description: patterns[8:0] selects nine fill/verify passes, seed[31:16] (zero becomes1).

registers.name: CONFIG_CAPTURE_OWNER
registers.description: capture slot[1:0], capture delay[5:2], owner[31:30]0PARK/1CPU/2TEST (3invalid).

registers.name: CONFIG_TAPS
registers.description: 80-bit packed16x5bit IDELAY requests in three words0x50,0x54,0x58; upper16 ofthird are unused. APPLY taps only parked through command7.

registers.name: CONFIG_TAG
registers.description: Four metadata words through0x68; not measured frequency proof.

registers.name: SNAPSHOT
registers.description: 40 frozen words through0x19c; updated by completed mailbox operations. [0]status,[1]work,[2]total,[3]compares,[4]expected,[5]errors,[6]runID,[7]base,[8]count,[9]seed/patterns,[10..12]firsterror,[13]refresh,[14]tap/capture,[15]ST41identity,[16..31]DQerrors,[32..35]tag,[36..38]actual taps plus CPU response bits,[39]CPU data. Telemetry status bits0busy,1done,2passed,3failed,4invalid,5aborted,6needs_reset,7initialized,8fatal,9alignfault,10quiescent,11start_ready,12reading; error code[19:16].

registers.name: CLOCK_ID
registers.description: S4C1 dedicated clock bank identity.

registers.name: CLOCK_COMMAND_STATUS
registers.description: Write1 full strobes applies staged clock only when safe/notbusy. Read bit0busy,1ready,2locked,3rejected,4reconfig_safe,error[15:8].

registers.name: CLOCK_COMPLETIONS
registers.description: Clock operation completion count; includes rejected/failed.

registers.name: CLOCK_EPOCH
registers.description: Successful clock configuration count.

registers.name: CLOCK_M8
registers.description: Multiplier times8. M8=96D..192D and<=512.

registers.name: CLOCK_LOGICAL_D
registers.description: Logical DIVCLK1..5 in50MHz ABI; physical DIVCLK=2D at100MHz host.

registers.name: CLOCK_O
registers.description: Output divider3..7; frequency=6250000*M8/(D*O),166..250MHz.

registers.name: CLOCK_SERIAL_PHASE
registers.description: 0..360000 millidegrees; round ticks=(phase*O+22500)/45000.

registers.name: CLOCK_QUARTER_PHASE
registers.description: 0..90000 millidegrees; round ticks=(phase*O*4+22500)/45000; must equal serial ticks.

registers.name: CLOCK_METADATA
registers.description: Requested kHz metadata only; hardware derives actual frequency independently.

registers.name: CLOCK_NOMINAL_HZ
registers.description: Rounded calculated Hz, not independent pin measurement.

registers.name: CLOCK_COMMAND_KHZ
registers.description: Measured serial-equivalent command kHz from internal quarter-rate meter.

registers.name: CLOCK_READ_KHZ
registers.description: Measured serial-equivalent read kHz from internal quarter-rate meter.

registers.name: CLOCK_ACTIVE_CONFIG
registers.description: Six active profile words through0x1074; not necessarily successfully locked until ready/epoch checks.
